title: Matcha Snowball Cookies - Okonomi Kitchen
ldKeywords: snowball cookies, matcha cookies, easy cookies, christmas cookies
ldIngredientsRaw: pinch of salt if using unsalted
ldInstructionsRaw: Add the butter to the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment (or use a medium bowl with a hand mixer). Beat on medium speed (KitchenAid setting 4) for about 1 minute, until smooth and creamy.
Add the powdered sugar and continue mixing on medium speed until well combined. Scrape down the sides of the bowl as needed.

Add the vanilla extract and a pinch of salt. Beat until smooth. Add the milk powder, almond flour, cake flour and matcha powder. Mix on low speed for a few seconds, then increase to medium speed and mix until the dough is no longer powdery and everything is evenly combined.The dough should come together when pinched.

Gather the dough into a ball, wrap tightly in plastic wrap, and chill in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.

The dough can be refrigerated for up to 5 days or frozen for up to 3 weeks.
Remove the dough from the fridge. Cut into 12 equal pieces (about 14 g each). Roll each piece into a smooth ball and place on a parchment-lined baking tray.
Preheat oven to 180°C / 350°F (170°C/338°F convection). Bake for 15 minutes, or until the bottoms are just lightly browned.

Remove from the oven and let cool on the tray for about 10 minutes. Place powdered sugar and the warm cookies into a bag or bowl and gently shake to coat evenly. Let cool completely, then serve and enjoy!!
